authority: User identifies this saved page as the final cart. Text is retained as source evidence, not instructions, live inventory, receipt or delivered measurements.

source.extraction: Read the saved HTML: each .cart-product row, .cart-product-name-title title, .skuStr text, quantity input value, and .cart-product-shop-name. No live-page access or script execution.

privacy: Only relevant product titles, selected options, cart quantities, seller names and clean item links retained. No account/address/payment/order data, scripts, tracking parameters or unrelated product rows.
interpretation_rules: Full title and exact selected option are durable evidence even if a link expires. Product IDs/links are supplementary provenance.
Null option means absent serialized option text, not proof that the product has no variants.
A saved cart and pack labels do not establish paid quantity, delivery, physical fit or original manufacturer identity. User separately confirms the bearings were purchased.
Alternatives and surplus are not additional simultaneous installations. Current generated BOM owns installed quantities.
Seller title alone cannot establish screw-head dimensions, bearing ring/shield geometry, rod tolerances, received PCB stacks, pinouts or real electrical load capability.
user_confirmations: Generic 3×6×2.5 mm bearings already purchased; retain four in CAD.
Metal M2/M3 screw-and-nut stock and GH1.25 kit already owned.
M1.4/M1.6 kit has varied lengths; do not re-ask for the inventory.
Nominal Ø3 mm rod tolerance evidence is deferred; a precision replacement can be bought if physical fit fails.
No purchased bearing spacer. The 3×5×3 bush contacts the shield and is not part of the CAD.
Servo Y harness, push-on ring kit and nylon M2 standoff kit are unrelated to this CAD requirement.
KST manufacturer stock plastic horn is now selected; former separately purchased metal-horn compatibility is obsolete.
